raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Purpose Add a Triton FusedMoE config measured on NVIDIA H20 for Gemma 4 26B-A4B (E=128, N=704, TP1, BF16). Without it, vLLM logs `Using default MoE config` and falls back to the heuristic. Only one file is added: `E=128,N=704,device_name=NVIDIA_H20.json`. No code changes. ### Relationship to existing PRs - #60504 also ships `E=128,N=704,device_name=NVIDIA_H20.json`. Its description does not include H20 measurements, and the config appears to be derived from a Hopper template. This PR is a config **searched and measured on H20** with `benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_moe.py --tune`. If #60504 lands first, this PR would only replace that single file; I am happy to rebase or close in favor of updating it there, whichever the maintainers prefer. - #45789 (benchmark_moe Gemma4 support) is not duplicated here. On v0.31.0 the script needs a one-line local patch to recognize `Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration` (same branch as `DiffusionGemmaForBlockDiffusion`) before it can tune this model. ## Test Plan Environment: 1x H20 96GB, driver 595.58.03, `vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0` (PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130, Triton 3.7.1), model `google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it`. Tuning: ```bash python3 benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_moe.py --model google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it \ --tp-size 1 --dtype auto --tune --save-dir tuned \ --batch-size 1 2 4 8 16 24 32 48 64 96 128 256 512 1024 1536 2048 3072 4096 ``` Kernel A/B: the same script without `--tune`, with `VLLM_TUNED_CONFIG_FOLDER` unset (default) / pointing at #60504's H20 file / pointing at this file. End to end: single replica, TP1, `--kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-num-seqs 32 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192`, MTP (`num_speculative_tokens=4`), guidellm 0.7.4. Decode uses 2000 real first-turn ShareGPT conversations (`/v1/chat/completions`, no `ignore_eos`, `max_tokens=1024`, 90 s per level). Prefill uses 1024-token unique-prefix prompts (60 s per level, prefix-cache hits verified 0). Startup log confirms `Using configuration from .../E=128,N=704,device_name=NVIDIA_H20.json for MoE layer.` ## Test Result Kernel time per MoE layer (us, lower is better; percentages are change vs default): | batch | default | #60504 H20 | this PR | |---|---|---|---| | 4 | 136.2 | 139.8 (+2.7%) | 124.5 (-8.6%) | | 16 | 316.6 | 317.0 (+0.1%) | 306.5 (-3.2%) | | 32 | 430.6 | 430.3 (-0.1%) | 414.4 (-3.7%) | | 64 | 629.2 | 486.4 (-22.7%) | 476.2 (-24.3%) | | 128 | 735.5 | 522.9 (-28.9%) | 488.5 (-33.6%) | | 256 | 743.8 | 704.6 (-5.3%) | 627.1 (-15.7%) | | 1024 | 1481.6 | 1099.1 (-25.8%) | 1085.3 (-26.7%) | | 4096 | 3614.9 | 3282.0 (-9.2%) | 3252.6 (-10.0%) | End to end, default config vs this PR (percentages are change vs default): | Decode concurrency | output tok/s | ITL p50 (ms) | |---|---|---| | 1 | 208.2 -> 212.9 (+2.3%) | 4.98 -> 4.82 (-3.2%) | | 4 | 745.2 -> 774.8 (+4.0%) | 5.18 -> 5.02 (-3.1%) | | 8 | 1079.4 -> 1266.0 (+17.3%) | 7.04 -> 6.10 (-13.4%) | | 16 | 1721.2 -> 1902.7 (+10.5%) | 8.84 -> 7.94 (-10.2%) | | 32 | 2296.9 -> 2731.4 (+18.9%) | 12.46 -> 10.72 (-14.0%) | | Prefill concurrency (1024 tok) | total tok/s | TTFT p50 (ms) | |---|---|---| | 1 | 11643 -> 13652 (+17.3%) | 86 -> 73 (-15.1%) | | 4 | 15231 -> 16645 (+9.3%) | 269 -> 246 (-8.6%) | | 32 | 17875 -> 18368 (+2.8%) | 1835 -> 1774 (-3.3%) | GSM8K (all 1319 test questions, 5-shot chat, greedy, `max_tokens=1024`, same MTP serving flags; scored with a small in-house script that follows lm-eval's flexible/strict extraction rules, not lm-eval itself): | | flexible-extract | strict-match | |---|---|---| | default config | 94.47% (1246/1319) | 94.54% (1247/1319) | | this PR | 94.24% (1243/1319) | 94.39% (1245/1319) | Stderr is about 0.63 points. Per question (flexible), 14 flip to correct and 17 flip to wrong; 586/1319 outputs are textually identical, consistent with a different Triton reduction order changing near-tie greedy tokens. The two arms ran on different pod instances of the same node. ## AI assistance This PR was prepared with AI assistance (Claude). The measurements above were executed by an AI agent on the submitter's cluster; the submitter reviewed the config and the results.
